notes.title: Thank you for all the reviews, here are the "Comming Soon" updates.
notes.content:
Thanks for all your helpful reviews; your comments are my motivations.
In the later version of this game, I will add several features to improve this game.
- Improve the scoring system. When you get close to the center of the platform, you will get a bonus score. The closer you get, the more score you will get.
- I see that it is difficult to catch the beat. I will add some feature to help players find the beat.
- The method of playing can be changed. You can choose to hold the spacebar or other keys, while you can also tap to turn.
- New songs and I am about to add a new game mode. 
Again, Thanks for all your reviews. Hope you can enjoy this game soon.ːsteamhappyː
P.S. For the one who cannot find the beat of the game, I highly recommend you to try to tap the spacebar at the center of each platform. It will be easier to find the rhythm of the song if you try to do so.
